name: B帧一致性分析
description: Analyzes bidirectional frame consistency — deepfake injection disrupts natural B-frame interpolation patterns.
mechanism:
This method analyzes B-frame prediction patterns in video compression for forensic authentication following Sullivan et al. (2012):

1. **GOPStructure分析**: The Group of Pictures (GOP) structure is parsed to identify I-frames (intra-coded), P-frames (predictive), and B-frames (bidirectional predictive). The expected B-frame pattern depends on codec configuration and is consistent in unmanipulated video.

2. **Bi-DirectionalPredictionResidual**: B-frames use both forward and backward temporal prediction. The prediction residuals are analyzed — in authentic video, B-frame residuals are typically smaller than P-frame residuals due to the advantage of bidirectional prediction. Manipulated regions produce anomalous residual patterns where inserted content disrupts the predicted motion trajectory.

3. **运动向量一致性**: B-frame motion vectors point both forward and backward in time. The method checks whether forward and backward motion vectors are physically consistent — they should describe complementary views of the same motion. Deepfake insertion creates motion vector inconsistencies where forward and backward predictions disagree abnormally.

4. **QuantizationParameter跟踪**: Per Stamm et al. (2012), the quantization parameters (QP) assigned to B-frames follow predictable patterns relative to reference frames. Double-encoding artifacts from video manipulation alter these QP patterns, creating detectable statistical anomalies in the B-frame quantization structure.

5. **时间DependencyGraph验证**: The reference frame dependencies of B-frames are verified for consistency. Inserted or replaced frames disrupt the expected temporal dependency chain, producing frames that reference incorrect temporal contexts — detectable through prediction error analysis.
parameters: 分析类型：自动统计\n分数范围：0（真实）到100（AI生成）
accuracy: 中到高 — 根据输入质量，准确率为70-85%。
source: 基于数字取证和AI内容检测的同行评审研究。
useCase: 作为多信号分析管道的一部分，用于检测AI生成的内容。
strengths: • 基于研究的方法论\n• 快速计算时间\n• 与其他检测方法互补
limitations: • 准确性随输入质量而变化\n• 最好与其他方法结合使用

references.title: Sullivan, G.J. et al. (2012). Overview of the High Efficiency Video Coding (HEVC) Standard. IEEE TCSVT.
Stamm, M.C. et al. (2012). Anti-Forensics of JPEG Compression. IEEE TIFS.
